checks.text: On first load with no saved state, the page shows the heading "Lights Out", the text "Moves: 0", and the board displays exactly 13 lit cells (the fixed seed 42 pattern).
Clicking the cell at row 1, column 1 (top-left) toggles it and its right and bottom neighbors; the number of lit cells changes from 13 to 10, and the text "Moves: 1" appears.

After clicking the cell at row 1, column 1, clicking the cell at row 1, column 2 toggles it, its left neighbor (row 1, col 1), its right neighbor (row 1, col 3), and its bottom neighbor (row 2, col 2); the move counter shows "Moves: 2".

Solving the puzzle by clicking the sequence of cells: (1,1), (1,2), (1,3), (1,4), (1,5), (2,1), (2,2), (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (3,1), (3,2), (3,3), (3,4), (3,5), (4,1), (4,2), (4,3), (4,4), (4,5), (5,1), (5,2), (5,3), (5,4), (5,5) results in 0 lit cells, the text "Solved!" appears, and the move counter shows "Moves: 25".
After solving the puzzle with 25 moves, clicking the button "New Game" resets the board to the seed 42 pattern (13 lit cells), resets the move counter to "Moves: 0", and removes the "Solved!" text.
After solving the puzzle with 25 moves, the text "Best: 25" appears. After clicking "New Game" and solving again with 25 moves, the text "Best: 25" remains unchanged.
After solving the puzzle with 25 moves, reloading the page shows the text "Best: 25" and the board displays the seed 42 pattern (13 lit cells) with "Moves: 0".
Changing the field labelled "Seed" from "42" to "7" and clicking "New Game" generates a different board with exactly 11 lit cells, and the move counter shows "Moves: 0".
